original_question: Jerry na-atụ mkpụrụ okwe ịhụ isii. Kedụ otu ọzọ o nwekariri ị́ké ịtụ ya (akpọpụta ya dịka pesenti) ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ dị ugboro atọ karịa na ọ tụrụ ọnụọgụgụ abụọ enwere ị́ké ike nhatanha?
question_template: {name_male, Jerry}  na-atụ mkpụrụ okwe ịhụ {num_text_1, isii}. Kedụ otu ọzọ o nwekariri ị́ké ịtụ ya (akpọpụta ya dịka pesenti) ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụgụ dị elu karịa {num_digit_1, 3} karịa na ọ tụrụ {num_text_2, abụọ} ọnụọgụgụ abụọ enwere ị́ké ike nhatanha?
question_solution:
even_count = num_text_1 / 2  # number of even faces
answer = ((num_text_1 - num_digit_1) / num_text_1 - (even_count / num_text_1) ** num_text_2) * 100

num_text_1: ọkara narị na iri abụọ na ise
